transmission_channels.A_proportional: Applicable when the intermediate obligation is variable — revenue-share, cost-plus, renegotiable, or the intermediary absorbs the shock by cutting its own margin. The origin shock arrives as c x.
transmission_channels.B_counterparty: Applicable when the intermediate obligation is fixed — take-or-pay lease, ring-fenced cash. The downstream link is insulated until the upstream link's own coverage breaches, then takes a step of size c at once. The observed lockbox on CoreWeave contract revenues is evidence for this channel.
